identificationModule.briefTitle: POLA-R-CHP in the First-line Treatment of Transformed DLBCL
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Prospective, Multicenter, Phase II Study of POLA-R-CHP in the First-line Treatment of Transformed DLBCL

descriptionModule.briefSummary: This study aims to evaluate efficacy and safety of POLA-R-CHP in the treatment of patients with transformed DLBCL.
descriptionModule.detailedDescription: Patients with transformed DLBCL lack standard treatment. We intend to conduct a prospective, multicenter, phase II study in order to evaluate efficacy and safety of POLA-R-CHP as first-line treatment of patients with transformed DLBCL.

interventions.name: POLA-R-CHP
interventions.description: Pola-R-CHP is a combination of rituximab, cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, prednisone, and polatuzumab vedotin

primaryOutcomes.measure: 2-year progression-free survival (PFS) assessed by imaging examination
primaryOutcomes.description: the period from the date of patients sign informed consent to the observed progression of the disease or the occurrence of death for any reason
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From date of patients sign informed consent until the date of first documented progression or date of death from any cause, whichever came first, assessed up to 2 years

secondaryOutcomes.measure: complete remission rate assessed by imaging examination
secondaryOutcomes.description: the ratio of numbers of patients with complete response after 6 treatment cycles to all the participants
the period from the date of patients sign informed consent to the observed event for any reason
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From date of patients sign informed consent until the date of first documented event, progression or date of death from any cause, whichever came first, assessed up to 2 years

secondaryOutcomes.description: time between the date of patients sign informed consent and the date of death or the date of last follow-up time
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: From date of patients sign informed consent until the date of death or the date of last follow-up time, whichever came first, assessed up to 2 years

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Number of participants with treatment-related adverse events as assessed by CTCAE v5.0
secondaryOutcomes.description: number of participants with treatment-related adverse events as assessed by CTCAE v5.0
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: Through study completion, up to 2 years

otherOutcomes.description: Detection of tissue DNA biomarkers in the treatment of transformed diffuse large B cell lymphoma
otherOutcomes.timeFrame: Throughout the treatment period, up to 2 years
